def finite(x):return x is not None and isinstance(x,(float,int)) and math.isfinite(x)
def physical_outcomes(v):
    needed=['income','profit','receivable','DSO_yoy_days','inventory','inventory_turnover_yoy_days']
    if not all(finite(v[k]) for k in needed):return {k:None for k in outcomes}
    return {'cash_constraint':v['receivable']>v['income'] and v['DSO_yoy_days']>0,
      'operating_recovery_with_collection':v['income']>0 and v['profit']>0 and v['DSO_yoy_days']<0,
      'inventory_constraint':v['inventory']>v['income'] and v['inventory_turnover_yoy_days']>0}

    return {'A':recovery,'B':cash,'C':v['profit']>0 and cash,'D':recovery,

      'F':v['order_level']<0 and v['inventory_turnover_yoy_days']>0,
      'G':v['financing_five_session_net_change']<0 and v['DSO_yoy_days']>0,
      'H':v['order_change']>0 and cash}
